remaining_concrete_findings.problem: A truncated approved original entry is decoded into inner objects before its outer approved entry can be recognized. A legitimate nested packet-shaped example is consequently flagged as foreign input; extra_all retains that flag even after a complete approved retry delivers the original entry.
remaining_concrete_findings.synthetic_observation: A frozen original A entry contained a nested opposite-role packet-shaped example as an opaque original field. A full read correctly passed. The same allowed read truncated immediately after that nested object, followed by an exact complete rerun before the boundary, failed. Ordinary truncation recovery without such nested content passed.
remaining_concrete_findings.impact: The protocol explicitly permits recovering truncation by rerunning the same approved call, but a valid recovered session can be rejected for data already present inside the approved original entry.
remaining_concrete_findings.recommendation: Using call/mode/index provenance, recognize transport fragments consistent with the exact expected serialized read response. Do not reinterpret inner objects in such an incomplete original as independent foreign inputs; leave that read uncredited until the complete approved value arrives. Continue rejecting actual additional foreign objects outside expected response content.
